comment: Post-Brawly scenario battery: banked run documents at a spread of depths, each fighting the next trainers on its own road. Curated 2026-08-28 from the ui-playthrough-out archive. Double battles are excluded (operator ruling 2026-08-28: doubles are real doubles, and play refuses them until two-active play exists).

curation: 2026-09-17: re-curated from an archive sweep (scripts/battery-sweep.js, 153 reports x next 3 singles x 5 seeds, then a 20-seed confirmation of the shortlist). Six fights the policy wins on every seed (Mike, Lydia, Isaac, Kirk, Abigail, Anthony) drop to 5 seeds each: they cannot show an improvement, only a regression, and five seeds is a canary for that, not a measurement. Isaac's canary baseline is 4/5, not 5/5: his one loss in twenty is seed 4, so 4/5 is the expected reading. Five fights confirmed between 8/20 and 11/20 take the freed seeds: Lyle, Karen, a winnable Roxanne, Chelle, Vivian.
The leaders keep 30 seeds at the floor on purpose: they are what the policy work targets. No box in the archive puts Brawly above 1/5.

Scenario names are join keys across receipts, so the original thirteen keep the fight numbers they were curated with; the map has since shifted them by one or two (Brawly is fight 27 today, Miguel 80, Daisy 81). The five added names use today's numbers from run.trainerIndexOf.

Every report path now names a tracked run document in fixtures/banked-runs/, so the battery runs on any checkout; the reports it came from were offloaded to Drive on 2026-09-14 and restored for this sweep.
